clips.name: walk
clips.prompt: A person walks forward at a normal everyday pace, taking full steps and swinging the arms naturally, and keeps walking straight ahead.

clips.name: window
clips.prompt: A person stands at a waist-high window sill, leans forward and rests both forearms on the sill, looking out of the window, slowly turning the head.

clips.name: stretch
clips.prompt: A person sitting on a chair raises both arms high above the head and stretches, arching the back and yawning, then lowers the arms and relaxes.

clips.name: lie_back
clips.prompt: A person lies flat on their back on the floor and holds a phone up above the face with both arms raised, looking at the phone and scrolling.

clips.name: turn_over
clips.prompt: A person lying on their back on the floor rolls over onto their left side, pulling the knees up a little, and lies still.

clips.name: type
clips.prompt: A person sits on a chair at a desk with both hands forward on a keyboard, typing, and now and then moves the right hand to a mouse.

clips.name: door
clips.prompt: A person reaches forward with the left hand to a door handle at waist height, pulls the door open towards themselves while stepping back with the left foot, and lets go.
